causes.quote: On Tuesday 23 January demand reached near-record levels in Queensland.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: A planned network outage at Tarong, combined with the unplanned loss of a 120 MW Swanbank generating unit, caused a system security issue for power flows from Tarong into Brisbane.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora
interconnectors_named.quote: The Terranora interconnector was also flowing counter price during this period, with a system normal constraint forcing a flow of around 110 MW south from midday to 4.30 pm.

intervals.quote: On Tuesday 23 January, the spot price in Queensland exceeded $5000/MWh in two trading intervals, reaching $5920/MWh and $7939/MWh at 3 pm and 3.30 pm respectively.

network_outages.quote: A planned network outage at Tarong, combined with the unplanned loss of a 120 MW Swanbank generating unit, caused a system security issue for power flows from Tarong into Brisbane.
